question: Select the most appropriate antonym of the word: Euphemism
solution:
The correct answer is: **Directness**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Euphemism"** refers to the use of polite or mild expressions to replace harsh or unpleasant words. (शिष्ट शब्दावली)
 
 
• **Example:** Saying "passed away" is a euphemism for "died."
 
 
• **"Directness"** refers to the quality of being straightforward and explicit without using subtle or polite expressions. (सपष्टता)
 
 
• **Example:** His directness in addressing the issue was appreciated by everyone.
 
 
• Hence, the antonym of **'Euphemism'** is **'Directness'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Directness**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Ambiguity** (अस्पष्टता): The quality of being unclear or open to multiple interpretations.
 
 
• **Example:** The ambiguity in his answer made it difficult to understand his actual intentions.
 
 
 
• **Politeness** (शिष्टता): The quality of showing good manners or being respectful.
 
 
• **Example:** She thanked her guests with great politeness.
 
 
 
• **Formality** (औपचारिकता): Adherence to conventional rules or etiquette.
 
 
• **Example:** The meeting was conducted with a high degree of formality.
 
 

42:T66b,

The correct answer is **option 2.**
